entries.title: A refused local network shows at once instead of Looking
entries.body: In Settings, on Devices, adding a computer by its address could show Looking for up to 20 seconds after macOS had refused local network access (Mac only). The same fix stops a look that failed at once, such as on Linux when this computer cannot look for others on its network, from staying off the screen. You can still type an address.
entries.noPicture: The lines are already on the address aside. A still picture cannot show an older answer arriving after a newer push.
